_comment: forest_portal: Map 3's finish line. Two living trunks either side of the opening, braided over the top into a pointed arch, with branches arching over into leaf clumps; the forest's own emissive swirl hangs inside as the effect surface -- sunlit yellow-green arms on leaf shadow round a gold-white core -- its own 64x64 file (forest_portal_swirl_albedo, albedo and glow both) on the disc, unwrapped planar, portal.glb's disc in shape, size and emission, in Map 3's palette. 4.5 x 4.0 x 0.8 m, origin at the base centre, y=0 is the ground; the disc lies in local XY at z=0 so a runner passes through along local Z, exactly as portal.glb. ONE connected mesh: the disc is fanned off the frame's own y=0 vertex row, it does not float. Three textured materials (the frame's bark and leaf on the forest's keeper tiles; the disc on the swirl), one UV set, no skin, no animation. ForestPortalCollision is the same two jambs and the same arched head coarsened to a four-sided prism ring -- not a box -- shipped as a `-colonly` node, leaving |x| <= 1.30 clear from the ground to z = 2.8 (portal.glb's hole, to the centimetre; the disc has no collision). Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` stays 2 and `max_tris` counts only what is drawn.
